item.title: Continuous Parameter Markov Processes and Stochastic Differential Equations
item.description: I originally read this text while it was being typeset around 2014. After bouncing off a number of resources on stochastic differential equations, I found this text finally presented the theory with enough foundational discussion and explicit examples to make It"o calculus intuitive. The Stochastic Integral
